blocker.summary: r481 (Piste B of the approved plan) committed the native source backlog that 27 consecutive cycles (r454-r480) built on, tested, and verified without regression. Reviewed the full diff (17 modified + 5 untracked files, 8070 working-tree diff lines): no secrets found, the three diagnostic fprintf traces added during the campaign (r459/r461/r478) are all gated by AC6_NATIVE_VD_TRACE and are legitimate permanent tooling, not scratch. Found and deliberately excluded one orphaned scratch file (native/src/native_vulkan_backend.cpp.new_header_part, an old superseded header draft) -- left on disk, not committed, not deleted. Committed as a single synthesized commit (7dec3f57) rather than split by subsystem, since the files are tightly interdependent (new native_pinned_shaders.h/native_vulkan_device.h included by native_vulkan_backend.cpp, CMakeLists.txt wiring) and splitting without verifying each intermediate build was judged riskier than one clear commit. Verified the full triptych (three contract audits, native ctest, root ctest, live --probe-entry probe) both before and after committing: identical results each time (native ctest 11/11, root ctest only the pre-existing unrelated ac6-cpp-complexity failure, probe presented_frames=5 state=2 capture non_black=0 distinct_colors=1 -- Piste A's open goal, unaffected by this commit). Named for r482: Piste B is closed. Piste C (HUD guard-rail, reconstruction/ace-combat-6, independent of this product) is next and ready to start. Piste A remains paused at r480 pending explicit user decision to resume. The orphaned scratch file remains on disk awaiting a future explicit delete/keep decision.
